players.product: Recursion OS, biological foundation models, and Lab-in-the-Loop

quarterly_data.signal: Recursion's 8-K (Item 2.02, preliminary and unaudited): cash, cash equivalents and restricted cash were approximately $561 million at September 30, 2026; with the proceeds of the concurrent offering, Recursion expects its cash to fund operating expenses and capital expenditure requirements into 2029. The October 2026 corporate presentation adds approximately 40% lower cash OpEx based on 2026 year-to-date trends versus the comparable 2024 period.

Recursion's 8-K (Item 8.01) adds REC-1245 (RBM39 degrader) dose-escalation detail beyond the release: across all dose levels 14 of 21 efficacy-evaluable patients (66.7%) achieved disease control at 8 weeks (deck: 'Overall DCR at 8 weeks across doses: 66.7% (14/21)'); 22 of 30 safety-evaluable patients (73.3%) had treatment-related adverse events and eight (26.7%) had Grade 3 or higher; at 65 mg three of four DLT-evaluable patients had dose-limiting toxicities and the MTD was exceeded, and the HCC patient with a 55.9% unconfirmed partial response withdrew because of toxicity. For REC-4881, the deck shows patients with 75% or greater total polyp burden reduction rising from 9% (December 2025) to 20% (September 2026).
quarterly_data.figure: REC-1245: 66.7% disease control across doses; 73.3% TRAEs, 26.7% Grade 3 or higher; MTD exceeded at 65 mg
